title.zh: Anthropic Says Claude Found Something Big in DNA. It Just Doesn't Know What
title.en: Anthropic Says Claude Found Something Big in DNA. It Just Doesn't Know What

current_state.zh: Anthropic announced that its Claude model autonomously mined DNA databases for 21 hours and flagged a previously unknown enzyme system, ART, hidden in bacteriophage genomes — a finding CRISPR co-inventor Feng Zhang called 'genuinely intriguing' even as Anthropic concedes its function and significance remain unknown.
